pool.english: The education system in Iraq needs reform.
My son is in primary school.
He is in his last year of high school.
The national exams decide your future.
The curriculum is long and heavy.
Understanding is more important than memorization.
Critical thinking is missing in schools.

pool.arabic: حتى تدخل طب، تحتاج معدل عالي.
pool.arabicTashkeel: حَتّى تِدخُل طِب، تِحتاج مُعَدَّل عالي.
pool.english: To enter medicine, you need a high average.
Teachers in state schools are good.
He chose the science branch in high school.
The whole family is stressed during the national exams.
They changed the curriculum this year.
The education system in Finland is famous.

pool.arabic: المدارس الأهلية تعلم إنكليزي من الصغر.
pool.arabicTashkeel: المَدارِس الأهلية تْعَلِّم إنكليزي مِن الصُّغُر.
pool.transliteration: il-madaaris il-ahliyya t3allim ingileezi min is-sughur.

pool.english: The primary school is near our house.

pool.arabic: الثالث متوسط بيه إمتحانات وزارية هم.
pool.arabicTashkeel: الثّالِث مُتَوَسِّط بيه إمتِحانات وِزارية هَم.
pool.english: The third year of middle school has national exams too.
pool.transliteration: ith-thaalith mutawassit bee imti7aanaat wizaariyya ham.

pool.english: High school students study day and night.
The national exam results come out in summer.
Understanding the lesson is the goal.

pool.arabic: أمي كانت تنطي دروس خصوصية بالبيت.
pool.arabicTashkeel: أُمّي كانَت تِنطي دُروس خُصوصية بالبيت.
pool.english: My mother gave private lessons at home.
pool.transliteration: ummi chaanat tinti duroos khusoosiyya bil-beet.

pool.english: Every teacher has a teaching method.
Reforming the education system takes years.

sentences.arabic: بالعراق، الأطفال يدرسون ست سنين إبتدائية، وثلاث متوسطة وثلاث إعدادية.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالعِراق، الأطفال يِدرسون سِت سِنين إبتِدائية، وثْلاث مُتَوَسِّطة وثْلاث إعدادية.
sentences.english: In Iraq, children study six years in primary school, three in middle school and three in high school.
sentences.transliteration: bil-3iraaq, il-atfaal yidrisoon sitt sneen ibtidaa2iyya, w-thlath mutawassita w-thlath i3daadiyya.

sentences.arabic: بنهاية الإعدادية أكو الإمتحانات الوزارية، وهي تقرر الجامعة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بنِهاية الإعدادية أكو الإمتِحانات الوِزارية، وهيَّ تْقَرِّر الجامعة.
sentences.english: At the end of high school there are the national exams, and they decide the university.
sentences.transliteration: b-nihaayat il-i3daadiyya aku il-imti7aanaat il-wizaariyya, w-hiyya tgarrir ij-jaam3a.

sentences.arabic: حتى تدرس طب، تحتاج معدل عالي كلش.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: حَتّى تِدرُس طِب، تِحتاج مُعَدَّل عالي كُلَّش.
sentences.english: To study medicine, you need a very high average.

sentences.arabic: لهذا أغلب الطلاب ياخذون دروس خصوصية.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: لِهَذا أغلَب الطُّلّاب ياخذون دُروس خُصوصية.
sentences.english: That's why most students take private lessons.
sentences.transliteration: li-haatha aghlab it-tullaab yaakhdhoon duroos khusoosiyya.

sentences.arabic: مدرسين هواية يقولون النظام يعتمد هواية عالحفظ، مو الفهم.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: مُدَرّسين هْوايَة يْقولون النِّظام يِعتِمِد هْوايَة عالحِفِظ، مو الفَهِم.
sentences.english: Many teachers say the system depends too much on memorization, not understanding.
sentences.transliteration: mudarriseen hwaaya ygooloon in-nidhaam yi3timid hwaaya 3al-7ifidh, moo il-fahim.

sentences.arabic: يريدون طرق تدريس جديدة تبني التفكير النقدي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: يْريدون طُرُق تَدريس جْديدة تِبني التَّفكير النَّقدي.
sentences.english: They want new teaching methods that build critical thinking.
sentences.transliteration: yreedoon turug tadrees jdeeda tibni it-tafkeer in-nagdi.

sentences.english: My neighbour sends her kids to a private school.

sentences.arabic: غالية، بس الصفوف زغيرة ويعلمون إنكليزي من الصغر.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: غالية، بَس الصُّفوف زْغيرة ويْعَلّمون إنكليزي مِن الصُّغُر.
sentences.english: It's expensive, but the classes are small and they teach English early.
sentences.transliteration: ghaalya, bas is-sufoof zgheera w-y3allimoon ingileezi min is-sughur.

sentences.arabic: جهالي يروحون لمدرسة حكومية، وشاطرين هواية.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: جْهالي يْروحون لمَدرَسة حُكومية، وشاطرين هْوايَة.
sentences.english: My kids go to a state school, and they are doing very well.

scenario.situation: The student is chatting with an Iraqi parent whose son is about to sit the national exams.
scenario.goalEnglish: Ask about the Iraqi school system (primary, middle, high school, national exams), compare it with your country's system, and discuss memorization versus understanding.
